{{Top|fa}} {{Otheruses|Hawk}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:HawkPhaseII-CATH.png]] |name=Hawk |homeworld=[[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' |birth= |death= |species=[[Human/Legends|Human]] {{C|[[Cloning/Legends|clone]]}}[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] |gender=[[Gender/Legends|Male]] |pronouns=He/him |donor=[[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]{{DB|organization|clonetroopers|clone troopers}} |height=1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color/Legends|Brown]] |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] **[[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] **[[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Welcome to paradise, rockjumpers.|Hawk, upon touching down on Teth|audio=Rockjumpers-TCWf.flac|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]}} '''Hawk''' was the name and [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|clone trooper lieutenant]] and [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. An expert [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Hawk was named for his highly precise [[Hawk (animal)/Legends|hawk]]-like [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He saw action, particularly with the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]], on many [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] during the war, including [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]]. During a [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|battle]] there in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he rescued a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] strike team led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after a thwarted [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] attempt to [[Ground warfare/Legends|ambush]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. During a [[Battle of Teth/Legends|following operation]] to rescue [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]], the son of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], Hawk ferried Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], along with [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] from the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], to the surface of [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] aboard an [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]]. After landing on Teth, Skywalker's forces began an assault to reach the [[B'omarr Monastery]] where Rotta was being held. Both campaigns resulted in victories for the Republic. When the Republic launched an [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|invasion]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] to retake [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] from the Confederacy, Hawk was among the [[Troop/Legends|troops]] dispatched as part of the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army's]] landing force. At the outset of the battle, Hawk served with the 501st Legion, [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] Skywalker, CT-7567, and their men to the planet's surface via [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] despite thick ground fire from the [[Umbaran militia]]. On a later assignment around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], he covertly inserted Skywalker, CT-7567, Tano, and Kenobi onto [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] aboard a [[Valkyrie 2929 (Nu-class)/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] so that the four [[Officer/Legends|officers]] could train a group of [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebel soldiers]] to retake their world from the Confederacy. Hawk flew a [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighter]] during Skywalker's [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|invasion]] of [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], helping to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|clear out]] the Separatist ground forces stationed outside the [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]] of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]. Yet, a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] that Hawk shot down during the battle inadvertently led to the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], the leader of the Banking Clan, when the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] crashed into his [[Clovis' office/Legends|office]]. ==Biography== ===Christophsis and Teth=== {{Quote|Gunship, come in. Hawk, we need an evac in the south tower.''"
"''Roger that, sir. We're coming.|Anakin Skywalker calls Hawk for an evacuation|audio=HawkEvac-THE.flac|{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy|d=y}}}} The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] with the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] and name Hawk was decanted from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and developed as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Named for his [[Hawk (animal)/Legends|hawk]]-like [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], Hawk was trained in combat, military tactics, and [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|piloting]], and he became well-noted for his [[Pilot/Legends|skill]] with the latter. He served as a [[Clone Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] and participated in many campaigns during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] on an array of worlds, often serving with [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]].{{SWE|technology|republicgunship|Republic attack gunship}} In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], seven [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]] into the war,''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' Hawk was dispatched with a contingent of clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] to [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|liberate]] the planet [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The Republic [[Troop/Legends|troops]], led by Skywalker and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], planned to [[Ground warfare/Legends|attack]] the Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] from a [[Christophsis double-towered building/Legends|business complex]] with towers situated to the north and south of the [[Droid/Legends|droids]]' route. However, the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist army]] ambushed Kenobi's forces in the south tower, and Skywalker responded from his position in the north tower by requesting Hawk and his [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunship]] for an evacuation from the south tower.{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}} [[File:Hawkgunshipevac.png|thumb|left|250px|Hawk's gunship arrives to rescue Skywalker and Kenobi from the foiled ambush.]] While Hawk headed for the south tower, Skywalker, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex, and their men proceeded there to reinforce Kenobi. After regrouping, Skywalker and Kenobi made their way to the tower's roof, and Hawk's [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] touched down near the edge of the roof just as [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droids]] caught up with the beleaguered [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clones. The Republic troops piled onto Hawk's gunship, taking the pilfered cranial unit of the Confederate [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TJ-55/Legends|TJ-55]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]], "Jedi Temple Archives" Blu-ray feature for "[[The Hidden Enemy]]" with them so as to uncover more information about the foiled ambush. Hawk returned the weary troops to the [[Christophsis Republic base/Legends|Republic base]], where debriefing began on the failed assault. Following several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of fighting, Skywalker and Kenobi defeated the Separatist forces on Christophsis and freed the world from droid occupation. Immediately after their victory, Skywalker was dispatched with his recently assigned [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], to the planet [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], where they were to [[Battle of Teth/Legends|retrieve]] [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Huttlet]], the son of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], to win Jabba's favor so that the Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] could be granted safe passage through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt-controlled space]]. Skywalker was given only one [[Time/Legends|planetary rotation]] to return Rotta to his [[Parent/Legends|father]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Furthermore, Rotta was being held at an [[B'omarr Monastery|abandoned monastery]] on Teth, a clifftop stronghold guarded by two [[Battalion/Legends|battalions]] of battle droids. Because the Republic [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] was unable to directly land there, Skywalker instead elected to deploy his troops in the jungle below the cliff and commence a vertical assault up the ridge. Hawk was among the pilots chosen for the gunship deployment, and he recognized the dangerous lack of cover at the drop-off and extraction sites. Launching from Skywalker's [[Anakin Skywalker's Acclamator-class assault ship (Teth)/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] alongside the other pilots, Hawk, piloting the battle group's lead gunship,[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' junior novelization]] ferried Skywalker, Tano, Rex, and a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] to the jungle of Teth. En route to the landing site, Hawk received orders from Skywalker to pull out of the drop zone once they had been deployed, as Skywalker wanted him to be standing by for an extraction from the monastery. Once [[DSD1 dwarf spider droid/Legends|DSD1 dwarf spider droids]] opened fire on the gunship from their position at the monastery, Hawk closed the [[Starship/Legends|craft's]] [[Blast shield (gunship)/Legends|blast shields]] and maintained his course to the jungle landing site. After the [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] managed to land them in the dense jungle, Skywalker, Rex, and Tano led Torrent [[Company/Legends|Company]] in the half-mile climb''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' to the monastery. Despite heavy [[Death/Legends|casualties]], Skywalker and Tano were able to rescue Rotta and [[Mission to Jabba's Palace (Clone Wars)/Legends|return]] him to his father. ===Separatist battlefronts=== {{Quote|General Skywalker, I've turned the lights out. Our night vision sensors are having a tough time in this chop. I hope we don't overshoot the landing site.''"
"''Just get us as close as you can.|Hawk and Anakin Skywalker, during the landing on Umbara|{{TCW|Darkness on Umbara}}}} [[File:HawkPhaseII-Darkness.jpg|thumb|250px|Hawk pilots Skywalker and Rex to the surface of Umbara aboard a space gunship.]] Late in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the war's second [[Standard year/Legends|year]],{{FactFile2014|7|KAT 1-2|King Katuunko}} Hawk{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/darkness-on-umbara-episode-guide|text="Darkness on Umbara" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} was dispatched as part of a Republic task force sent to invade and [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|retake]] the planet [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], which had recently seceded from the Republic to join the Confederacy of Independent Systems.{{SWE|locations|umbara|Umbara}} Hawk initially served aboard an [[Unidentified Acclamator-class assault ship (Umbara)|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] commanded by Skywalker and Kenobi, which was the first [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] of the Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to [[Space warfare/Legends|break through]] the Separatists' [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] of Umbara thanks to [[Starfighter combat/Legends|starfighter support]] from [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Jedi Commanders]] Tano and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. Once the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] had moved into position over Umbara to deploy Skywalker's and Kenobi's forces—alongside clone battalions led by Jedi [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] and [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]]—Hawk and a number of other clone pilots were tasked with [[Transport/Legends|transporting]] the Republic forces to the shadowy world's surface aboard [[Space gunship/Legends|space gunships]]. Hawk's passengers included Skywalker, Captain Rex, [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Fives/Legends|Fives]], and troops from the 501st Legion, including [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]], [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]], [[Tup/Legends|Tup]], and [[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]]. With [[Clone Z-95 starfighter/Legends|clone Z-95 starfighters]]{{SWE|technology|z95headhunter|clone Z-95 starfighter}} flying as [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] support against attacking [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]], Hawk and the other gunship pilots steered their craft toward the predetermined landing site on Umbara's surface. The gunships' deployment was met with much enemy ground fire from the [[Umbaran militia]], and Hawk was forced to maneuver his gunship through the heavy flak. Even with [[Night vision/Legends|night vision]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], Hawk had a tough time trying to navigate through the dark [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], and he expressed his concern to Skywalker about the possibility of overshooting the landing zone. While other gunships landed early to launch [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]] against the advancing [[Umbaran soldier/Legends|Umbaran Soldiers]] and [[Umbaran hover tank/Legends|hover tanks]], Hawk continued on to the landing point and reached it intact. There, he deployed Skywalker, Rex, and their men to join the concentrated Republic effort to secure Umbara. Hawk was dispatched{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}} around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the final year of the war,[[Darth Maul — Death Sentence 1|''Darth Maul — Death Sentence'' 1]] to transport Skywalker, Tano, Rex, and Obi-Wan Kenobi to the planet [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. There, the four officers were to train a group of [[Onderon rebels/Legends|rebel soldiers]] to retake Onderon from Separatist control. Flying the [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] [[Valkyrie 2929 (Nu-class)/Legends|''Valkyrie 2929'']], Hawk inserted the four officers into the Onderon jungle by night, hovering over the drop point so that they could disembark, and then quickly pulled out to avoid being detected by the Separatists. Skywalker, Rex, Tano, and Kenobi found the rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela Gerrera]], who took them to the resistance's [[Onderon insurgent camp/Legends|secret base]] so that they could train the insurgents to [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|liberate]] their world. [[File:HawkZ95Scipio-CATH.png|thumb|left|250px|Hawk and other pilots provide starfighter escort for Skywalker's 501st gunships.]] Hawk later joined Skywalker's fleet when the 501st was dispatched to retake [[Scipio/Legends|Scipio]], the headquarters of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], which had recently [[Invasion of Scipio/Legends|fallen]] to the Confederacy. After Skywalker's three-cruiser armada arrived in{{TCW|Crisis at the Heart}} the [[Scipio system/Legends|Scipio system]],''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' Hawk and a number of other pilots flew clone Z-95 starfighters into combat against the Separatist [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla's]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]]. With Hawk and his comrades providing escort, Skywalker and Captain Rex made for the surface aboard a squadron of LAAT/i gunships to rescue [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who had been trapped on-world since the Separatists invaded. En route to the surface, Hawk reassured Skywalker that he and his fellow pilots would provide further air support for the ground assault. Once Hawk and his comrades had reached the planetary atmosphere, the Confederate fleet retreated from Scipio, abandoning the droid forces stationed outside the [[Main Vault/Legends|Main Vault]] of the Banking Clan. Hawk and the other pilots turned their [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] on the Vulture droids and [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|''Hyena''-class bombers]] that launched into combat against them, working together to pick off the enemy fighters. When Hawk noticed that another clone trooper pilot was being chased by a Vulture droid, he came to his comrade's rescue and gunned down the pursuant Vulture droid. Yet, the enemy fighter veered into the central spire of the Main Vault, where the [[Clovis' office/Legends|office]] of [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], the leader of the Banking Clan, was situated. After the Vulture droid crashed into the central spire, Clovis's office toppled, nearly plunging its current occupants—Clovis, Amidala, and Skywalker—off the side of the structure. Clovis sacrificed himself so that Skywalker could save Amidala. Despite Clovis's death, Hawk and his comrades emerged victorious on Scipio, helping to secure the banks and ending the crisis. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Long range shows a heavily defended target, sir. Laser-cannon emplacements, at the very least. We won't be undetected now, you do know that, don't you, sir? I'll drop below the tree canopy as soon as I get a clear run.''"
"''Good, then bang out as soon as we're down. I need you standing by for extraction.''"
"''Will do, sir.|Hawk and Anakin Skywalker|}} [[File:Hawk-TCWIV.png|thumb|right|180px|Hawk's custom Phase I armor at Christophsis]] As a Human male clone, Hawk stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall and was versed in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]. An expert pilot, his abilities impressed the likes of Jedi General Anakin Skywalker and Clone Captain Rex. He was thorough in his duties, and during the Battle of Teth, he kept Skywalker updated with comprehensive reports en route to Teth's surface. His experience in the war caused him to see the danger posed in his troop landings on Teth, as both the drop-off and extraction sites lacked proper cover from the Separatist droid forces entrenched there. He had eyes like a hawk [[Bird/Legends|bird]], which earned him his nickname. Hawk received combat training and had a knowledge of military tactics. He was capable in piloting LAAT/i gunships and flew a variant of the infantry gunship model, the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] gunship,{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode320.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Citadel Rescue}} at Umbara. He was also able to fly the ''Nu''-class attack [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] and the nimble clone Z-95 starfighter. ==Equipment== During the Battle of Christophsis, Hawk wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]], and his scarred [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] was customized with [[Color/Legends|blue]] markings and two red hawk "bird of prey" insignia. However, the clone trooper pilot armor he later wore at the Battle of Teth was standard issue, with yellow markings and the normal Galactic Republic insignia displayed on his helmet. After upgrading to [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] prior to the Battle of Umbara, Hawk adopted new equipment that was based on the armor suit that he had previously utilized at Christophsis; his new Phase II helmet featured variations of his Phase I blue markings and red hawk insignia. All of his armor suits were equipped with sensors that measured his vital signs. He wielded a [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15 blaster pistol]] in combat. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Clone pilot Hawk was originally in the ''Clone Wars'' movie, called by Anakin for an extraction from the B'omarr monastery on Teth. That sequence was cut from the movie—which may have ended up saving Hawk's life, because as it originally played out, that rescue gunship would have been shot down by a vulture droid.|"The Hidden Enemy" [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|Episode Guide]] clarifies the non-canon status of Hawk's appearance in the cut scene from ''The Clone Wars'' film|{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode016.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Hidden Enemy}}}} The character of Hawk was created for the [[August]] [[2008]] [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]], which served as an introduction to the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|television series]] of the same name. Hawk first appeared in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|film's novelization]], written by [[Karen Traviss]], and was later featured in "[[The Hidden Enemy]]," an episode in the television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] that was released in [[February]] [[2009]] as a prequel to the 2008 film. He received references in various source material following these appearances.''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Episode Guide: Season 1]]'' In [[October]] [[2011]], more than three years after his original creation, Hawk returned to the television series for a brief appearance in "[[Darkness on Umbara]]," which was released as part of the series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]]. Although he was not directly referred to by name in the episode, his appearance was confirmed by the episode's [http://www.starwars.com/explore/the-clone-wars/ep407/#!/media/slideshow corresponding online guide] on [[StarWars.com]]. He was later featured in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|fifth season]] episode "[[A War on Two Fronts]]" in October [[2012]], as well as in "[[Crisis at the Heart]]," an episode that was released in [[March]] [[2014]] with the series' [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth and final season]].{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/crisis-at-the-heart-episode-guide|text="Crisis at the Heart" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} [[File:HawkPreDeath-TCWf.png|thumb|left|250px|In a scene cut from the film, Hawk's gunship arrives at the monastery moments before being destroyed by a Vulture droid.]] As part of the Battle of Teth sequence in ''The Clone Wars'' film, Anakin Skywalker calls in a gunship for an evacuation from the Teth monastery, but the gunship is shot down by a Vulture droid starfighter, killing the pilot and all troops on board. That scene initially appeared in the film's novelization and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (junior novelization)|junior novelization]], though neither books identified the pilot of the gunship by name. Hawk was originally intended to be the pilot of the gunship in the film, but the scene was removed from the film's final version, thus maintaining that Hawk did not die at Teth. To date, Hawk's "death" has not been verified as [[canon]]ical, and the non-canon status of his appearance in the scene was solidified with his being featured in the chronologically later episode "Darkness on Umbara." Nevertheless, the cut scene itself—without Hawk as the named pilot—retained its canon status thanks to its canonization in the film's novelizations. Hawk's card in [[Clone Wars Tactics|''Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Clone Wars Tactics'']] depicted him in normal, white Phase I clone trooper armor at Teth{{SWPM|set=Clone Wars Tactics|cardname=Lieutenant Hawk}} instead of his standard-issue yellow-marked pilot armor, as seen in the film. A [[September]] [[2010]] video published on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' website showed Series Director [[Dave Filoni]] describing Hawk as a [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone trooper commander]],{{SW|url=video/the-clone-wars-answers-mash-troopers|text=The Clone Wars Answers: MASH Troopers?}} but this [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] has yet to be confirmed by an official source. Until such a confirmation, it is assumed to be an error. Additionally, a clone pilot who lacked Hawk's distinctive armor but whose role corresponded to that of Hawk in "The Hidden Enemy" appeared in the non-canonical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', which was released in March 2011. In the game, the pilot does not initially hear Skywalker's request for an evacuation because he is listening to [[Music/Legends|music]].''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'' ==Appearances==
